title: 18 · Fail-fast in Bank
objective: Reject bad input before changing the balance.
instructions: A Bank is created with a non-negative balance.
If it exceeds the balance, throw IllegalStateException.
On failure, the balance must not change.
hints: Check error conditions before deducting money.
An exception thrown by Java ends the method unless it is caught on the spot.
Separate the invalid-amount error from the insufficient-funds error.
